item.title: Wye NNR Stock Fence Renewal (SRP) 2026-27
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 21,650 Status: active Deadline: 2026-11-22T23:59:00Z
Renewal of 1,500m of stock fencing over the North Downs in Kent at Wye National Nature Reserve. Includes removal of existing fence, clearance of vegetation/scrub and installation of new fence. The steep terrain of the escarpment will require manual work in places where access for machinery and equipment is restricted. Works to commence late November with completion by 26th March 2027 (all vegetation clearance completed end of February, prior to nesting season).

item.title: NHSDG Estates & Property - Term Joinery Contractor
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 25,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-17T12:00:00Z
The key services being sought are in relation to Term Joinery Contractor are planned works, routine maintenance works, and unplanned reactive works from time to time. In addition, a 365 day emergency on call service is to be provided as part of this service and is applicable to NHSDG Estates properties throughout Dumfries & Galloway.
